title: WORIKSXEDIT
description: This is a 256x resolution vanilla texture pack, also designed for PvP
body:
# 💎 Vanilla HD 256x — The Ultimate Faithful Experience

Welcome to **Vanilla HD 256x**, a premium-quality resource pack designed for players who love the classic look of Minecraft but want a much sharper, crisper, and more modern visual experience. 

By upgrading the game's standard resolution to an ultra-detailed **256x256**, this pack bridges the gap between modern high-definition graphics and the nostalgic, blocky charm of vanilla Minecraft. Every texture has been meticulously upscaled and refined by hand to ensure that your builds, worlds, and items look incredibly sharp without losing their original identity.

## ✨ Key Features

* **Ultra-Crisp 256x Resolution:** Say goodbye to blurry pixels. Blocks, items, and environmental textures are now sharp, clear, and visually stunning even from a distance.
* **100% Vanilla Friendly:** We strictly preserve the original color palettes, shapes, and themes of Mojang's default textures. Your worlds will look exactly as intended, just beautifully enhanced.
* **Versatile & Gameplay-Ready:** Optimized perfectly for all playstyles:
  * **Survival:** Immerse yourself in a more realistic and detailed wilderness.
  * **Building:** Blocks connect seamlessly, providing clean lines for massive projects or cozy cottages.
  * **PvP / Competitive:** Clean UIs and clear item definitions ensure you never lose focus during intense combat.

## 🛠️ Recommended Settings & Compatibility

To ensure the best performance and visual quality at 256x resolution, we highly recommend using the following optimization mods:
